ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool that automatically audits industrial land compliance and unauthorized construction changes.
ideas.title: GeoAudit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Similar projects have won major hackathons like Xcelerate by combining high-utility computer vision with real-world civic and environmental impact, which appeals directly to judges looking for project completeness.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first, multilingual RAG voice assistant tailored for quick information retrieval in rural healthcare awareness and preventive care.
ideas.title: AuraVoice RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: By integrating localized speech recognition and retrieval-augmented generation similar to past winning entries like SAGACITY and Voz-AI, the project delivers immediate, measurable social impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that converts unstructured academic and technical recordings into searchable, timestamped transcripts.
ideas.title: DocuStream AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: It mirrors the exact architecture of LibrAI which won first prize at the Data & Design Hackathon by turning dense unstructured data into accessible, highly interactive interfaces.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform using LangGraph to guide university students through campus energy-saving challenges and carbon tracking.
ideas.title: Campus Green Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts proven multi-agent frameworks that recently won the GreenNovation Hackathon, ensuring high technical complexity coupled with an intuitive frontend demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: A simulated digital branch platform utilizing real-time face detection and secure document verification for frictionless loan applications.
ideas.title: VeriLoan Branch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of Team Incognito's Standard Chartered entry by streamlining bureaucratic workflows into an immersive, responsive web application.
